description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android voice calculator app, including UI initialization, voice input handling, calculator logic, history management, news ticker animation, and theme toggling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing UI, voice input, calculator logic, history drawer, news ticker, and theme toggling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity UI components, sets up voice input, keypad logic, history panel, and news ticker.

methods.name: setupNewsTicker
methods.description: Configures automatic scrolling news ticker with touch pause/resume.

methods.name: startNewsTickerAnimation
methods.description: Starts the scrolling animation for the news ticker.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the result display and saves the state for undo-redo.

methods.name: setupUndoRedoButtons
methods.description: Configures undo and redo button click listeners.

methods.name: updateUndoRedoButtonStates
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state of undo and redo buttons based on history.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression and updates the display and history.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Attaches click handlers to calculator keypad buttons, including clear and evaluate functions.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Initializes the history drawer UI and behavior.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Opens the history drawer with animation and populates it.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Closes the history drawer with animation.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Populates history drawer with calculation data and sets up delete/clear actions.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes the history panel if currently visible.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark themes.
